motion.name: shared-loop

motion.name: swell
motion.purpose: The single water field every moving element samples.

motion.name: tile-spring
motion.value: pushRadius 120px, push 1900, carry 2.6, stiffness 38, damping 6.5, lift 0.03
motion.purpose: TUNE defaults for pointer push and spring-back.

motion.name: ripple
motion.value: rippleSpeed 520px/s, rippleAmp 1.6, lifetime 2.2s, max 10 rings, swipe threshold 900px/s
motion.purpose: Rings from taps and fast swipes.

motion.name: beads
motion.purpose: Water drops sliding down the wall.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce -> loop never starts; one still frame per job

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Finished Shower Wall"**

The whole system is one material: the owner's own cobalt-tile, brass-fixture shower, read as a brand. Navy and gold are not chosen colors; they are the tile body and the grout and trim of a just-finished wall. Navy grounds carry the wall and the work; porcelain grounds are the grout-white between them, where the reading happens. Gold appears as trim (frames, outlines, the waterline) and as solid metal only on the primary button.

The wall is alive. On the two navy bookends (hero and close) a canvas draws glossy cobalt tiles that swell as if under running water, shove aside and spring back under a finger or cursor, ripple out from taps, and carry sliding water beads. The owner's job photos are set into that wall as gold-framed tiles that ride the same water. Everything else that moves (section seams, framed photos further down) samples the same swell, so the page has one tide rather than many effects.

Density is trade-promo direct: heavy uppercase display, short lines, big tap targets, a single gold action repeated at every decision point. Phone is the native surface; desktop is an adaptation of it.
keyCharacteristics: Two grounds only: deep navy and porcelain, alternating, joined by moving gold waterlines.
Gold is trim and metal, never a text-heavy surface beyond the primary button.
Heavy (900) uppercase system-sans display; plain 17px body.
Square-ish, tile-shaped geometry: 4-8px corners, 52px cobalt chips, gold-framed photos.
One shared animation loop, paused off screen, still under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: Every section is either navy or porcelain, and they alternate. No third ground, no gradients as grounds, no black.

rules.name: The Brass Is Trim Rule
rules.body: Gold outlines, frames, strokes and marks. Solid gold surfaces are limited to the primary button.

rules.name: The Cobalt Is Tile Rule
rules.body: Cobalt appears only where something is a tile: the wall, and the square chips that hold service icons and step numbers. It is never text and never a section ground.

rules.name: The Shout And Talk Rule
rules.body: Headings are 900 uppercase; nothing between 600 and 900 is used for headings, and body is never uppercase. If a line is not a heading, button, or the area line, it is sentence case.

rules.name: The Phone Is The Base Rule
rules.body: Write base styles for a 390px phone; desktop only ever adds a `min-width: 900px` adaptation. Tap targets are at least 44px; primary actions are 54-58px tall.

rules.name: The Objects Cast, Surfaces Don't Rule
rules.body: Only things that are physically set into or hung on the wall (photos, chips, dock) cast shadows. Sections, rows and text never do.

rules.name: The Waterline Rule
rules.body: Every ground change is a moving gold waterline seam, never a hard edge or a straight rule.

dos: **Do** keep every ground navy or porcelain, alternating, joined by a moving gold waterline seam.
**Do** make Text the gold primary and Call the outlined secondary, as one pair of equal height, repeated at hero, close and dock.
**Do** frame every job photo in a 4px gold border and let it ride the shared swell.
**Do** drive any new motion from the shared loop and `swell()`, register it for off-screen pausing, and give it a reduced-motion still frame.
**Do** expose new motion knobs in `TUNE` rather than as literals.
**Do** use Aged Brass, not Brass Gold, for small gold marks on porcelain.
**Do** write phone styles as the base and adapt at `min-width: 900px`.
donts: **Don't** use a black ground, or any section ground other than navy and porcelain.
**Don't** spread solid gold beyond the primary button.
**Don't** make information look clickable. The price is plain type: no box, no fill, no shadow, no arrow, no link (Ellie, 2026-10-08: too many things in the services section asked to be clicked).
**Don't** use cobalt for text or for a section ground; it is tile only.
**Don't** start a second animation loop or animate anything that keeps running off screen.
**Don't** set headings in anything but 900 uppercase, or body in uppercase.
**Don't** cut between sections with a straight edge.
**Don't** add shadows to sections, rows or text; only set objects cast.
